card.name: The word she after "he or"
card.fires_on: The word "she" right after "he or" when a doctor, child or person is referred to with a gendered pronoun pair. It fires at the end of the pair, just before the verb.

modes.label: Doctor as subject
modes.description: "he or she" refers to the doctor or provider who will examine or recommend something.
modes.example: Then he or<< she>> will collect a sample using a long cotton

modes.label: Child or person as subject
modes.description: "he or she" refers to a child, patient or generic person.
modes.example: Keep your child away from latex products if he or<< she>> has a latex allergy.

card.plain: It lights up on the "she" in "he or she" when a doctor, patient or child is being described.
